_readme: Flagship events worth tracking even when the aggregator feeds miss them.
'dates' is the curated floor (ISO start/end). The nightly build also scrapes
'url' and, when the page yields an explicit month-named date range, uses that
instead and stores the raw matched text in 'dates_evidence' — the page shows
you exactly which string each date came from.
A scraped date is only accepted if it parses AND falls on/after today, so a
stale year in some archive paragraph can never overwrite a real date.
Set refresh=false for a URL that does not resolve, so runs stay quiet.
Dates are never guessed: an unknown date is left TBA on purpose.

events.name: Current 2026 — San Francisco (Confluent)
events.cfp_note: Confluent's flagship data-streaming event and the successor to Kafka Summit. Speaker submissions run ahead of each edition — watch the site for the open call. The London edition ran May 19-20, 2026.
events.description: Apache Kafka and data streaming, from the people who maintain Kafka.

events.name: AWS re:Invent 2026
events.cfp_note: No general open CFP. Most breakouts are invited or customer-submitted through the AWS Community/Partner call, announced on the site — worth watching if you want a session.
events.description: AWS's flagship cloud and AI conference, with a large streaming/analytics track.

events.name: Community Over Code 2026 (Apache Software Foundation)
events.cfp_note: The ASF's annual conference — home to the Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Pulsar and Airflow project communities. Runs an open CFP each year; the 2026 call has closed.
events.description: The Apache Software Foundation community conference.

events.name: QCon — qconferences series
events.cfp_note: Practitioner conference with consistently strong data/streaming architecture tracks. Each edition runs its own call for speakers, typically ~4 months ahead.
events.description: Software architecture conference series with heavy data-engineering content.

events.name: Databricks Data + AI Summit 2027
events.cfp_note: Runs an open Call for Proposals a few months before the event — watch the site for the submission window.
events.description: Databricks' flagship data, analytics and AI conference (Delta Lake / lakehouse).

events.name: Data Council 2027
events.cfp_note: Independent, deeply technical data conference — the closest thing to a pure data-engineering community event. Runs an open call for speakers.
events.description: Independent data engineering and data infrastructure conference.

events.name: Google Cloud Next 2027
events.cfp_note: Sessions are largely curated by Google; the community/partner speaker call is announced on the site.
events.description: Google Cloud's flagship conference, including Dataflow/Pub-Sub streaming tracks.

events.name: dbt Coalesce 2027
events.cfp_note: The analytics-engineering community conference; runs an open call for speakers in the spring.

events.name: Snowflake Summit
events.cfp_note: Next edition's dates were not published on the page at build time — check back. Snowflake announces the agenda and any speaker call separately.

events.name: P99 CONF
events.cfp_note: Free online conference on high-performance / low-latency systems — very relevant to streaming internals. Dates not confirmed at build time.
events.description: Online conference about performance, concurrency and low-latency systems.

events.name: Apache Iceberg Summit
events.cfp_note: Next edition's dates are not published. The icebergsummit.com host did not resolve at build time — check the Apache Iceberg community channels.
events.description: Community summit for the Apache Iceberg open table format.

events.name: Flink Forward
events.cfp_note: The site still advertises the Barcelona 2025 edition (Oct 13-16, 2025); no 2026 dates or CFP are published yet. Flink Forward traditionally opens its call for speakers roughly 4 months ahead.

events.name: Kafka Summit
events.cfp_note: Kafka Summit has been folded into Confluent's Current conference — track 'Current' above for the Kafka community's main event. This site is archived.
events.description: Legacy Kafka community summit, now merged into Confluent Current.
